name: low-band-end-to-end
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
VC (control 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.01 2e-05 0.01]
DUT (control out) tuning_vco
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9 iabstol=1e-14
tran tran stop=2e-05 errpreset=conservative
save control out

simulator lang=spectre
global 0

DUT (control out) tuning_vco
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9 iabstol=1e-14
tran tran stop=2e-06 errpreset=conservative
